customdrops.config.title: Custom Drops
customdrops.config.overflow: You have %s entries but only the first %s fit in this editor. The rest are preserved unchanged - use the JSON files directly to manage all of them.
customdrops.config.condition.killedByPla: Only when killed by a player
customdrops.config.mobDrops.description: Control what a specific mob (or entity tag) drops when it dies. Each entry below can add up to two items on top of (or instead of) its normal drops.
customdrops.config.blockDrops.descriptio: Control what a specific block (or block tag) drops when broken.
customdrops.config.chestLoot.description: Control any loot table by its id - not just chests. Dungeon and village chests, trial chamber vault rewards, suspicious sand and gravel, and more all work here. See the Browse tab for real ids.
customdrops.config.fishingLoot.descripti: Control fishing-specific loot tables (the overall pool, or just the fish, junk, or treasure sub-pools). Works the same way as Chest Loot, kept separate for organization.
customdrops.config.equipment.description: Force a mob's held or worn item to always drop on death, instead of the normal small chance. This does not add new items - it only affects equipment the mob already spawned with.
customdrops.config.browse.empty: No bundled loot table list found - rebuild the mod so extractVanillaLootTables can run.
customdrops.config.browse.hint: %s known loot table ids. Type in the search box above to filter.
customdrops.config.serverInfo.notConnect: Not currently connected to a server running Custom Drops.
customdrops.config.presets.description: Picking a preset replaces every category's entries above with that preset's defaults. Leave on 'none' to configure everything yourself.
